title: Python Agent Migration Phase 2: Port Prompt Builder (12 modules) to engine/agent/prompt_builder/

sections.what: Port all 12 static/js/agent/prompt-builder/*.ts modules into engine/agent/prompt_builder/ reading Player, Graph, engine/language_barrier.py, engine/speech_tone.py, and engine/emotion_matrix/ directly, and expose POST /api/agent/prompt so the browser stops duplicating engine rules.
sections.why: Browser-side prompt assembly forces TypeScript to mirror Python engine rules (such as maskSpeechForListener duplicating engine/language_barrier.py) and prevents pytest from snapshot-testing real prompts directly.
sections.how:
1. Port system_prompt, schema_fragments, character_state, room_context, conversation_context, memory_context, contextual_actions, context_sections, and turn_prompts into engine/agent/prompt_builder/.
2. Expose POST /api/agent/prompt returning system + user prompt messages for think-decide and result-reaction phases.
3. Switch browser PromptBuilder callers to fetch from /api/agent/prompt and add pytest prompt snapshot tests.
sections.verify: pytest tests/ covers prompt generation against real Millwood and Mansion fixtures with zero browser dependency, and live play in browser produces identical turn prompts.

acceptance.text: engine/agent/prompt_builder/ builds system, think-decide, and result-reaction prompts directly from Python Player and Graph state.
POST /api/agent/prompt serves assembled prompts to the browser.
Duplicate TypeScript language-barrier and affect-rendering mirrors are retired.

custom.browser_ui: In live play mode, verify Agent Lens and the event stream raw-LLM drawer display the server-built prompts cleanly with zero console errors.
